A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  RECOMMENDATION TO ADOPT PHA RESOLUTION NO. 2022­004, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  PUBLIC HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS, COUNTY OF LOS
  ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA, CERTIFYING THAT THE PHA WILL CARRY OUT THE
  PUBLIC HOUSING PROGRAM OF THE AGENCY IN CONFORMITY WITH TITLE VI OF THE
  CIVIL RIGHTS ACT OF 1964, THE FAIR HOUSING ACT, SECTION 504 OF THE
  REHABILITATION ACT OF 1973, AND TITLE II OF THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT
  OF 1990, AND WILL AFFIRMATIVELY FURTHER FAIR HOUSING

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Gloria Thomas, Housing Rehab Supervisor, spoke; and presented the staff report.

  A motion was made by Director Mahar, seconded by Vice Chairmember Del Rio, to approve
  recommendation and adopt PHA Resolution No. 2022­004.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 7; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, Alvarado, Gomez, Mahar, Hernandez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 7–0–0–0
